title: Rectangle
promptMd:
Read width and height (integers). Store them in a **struct/class** that can compute area and perimeter, then print:

```
area 12
perimeter 14
```

requiredPatterns.message: Define a separate class (not Main) for the rectangle.

hints: The struct/class needs two fields: width and height.
Perimeter is the distance all the way around: two widths plus two heights.
Output format matters: a lowercase word, one space, the number.
